Name: Create Stripe subscription products and prices
Description: Set up three subscription tiers in Stripe Dashboard and confirm they match spec. Create products: Basic $29/month, Pro $49/month, Enterprise $99/month. Define features per tier: Basic = basic access to AI model selection tool + limited features; Pro = additional features + priority support; Enterprise = all features + custom support + integration options. Enable recurring billing monthly. Record Price IDs for backend use. Acceptance criteria: Products visible in Stripe, pricing correct, metadata includes tier name and feature set.

Name: Build pricing page with tier comparison
Description: Update frontend pricing page to display Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers with clear feature comparison table. Design should be clean and straightforward. Include prominent checkout button per tier. Add tooltip/help icon explaining plan change behavior later. Ensure design matches app branding. Acceptance criteria: Page renders three tiers with correct pricing and features, comparison is readable, CTA buttons trigger Stripe checkout flow.

Name: Implement Stripe Elements checkout form
Description: Build checkout flow using Stripe Elements on frontend. Style form to match app design. Handle validation errors gracefully for invalid card details, insufficient funds, etc. On successful payment, redirect user to dashboard and show confirmation. Acceptance criteria: Form renders securely, errors displayed clearly, successful checkout creates subscription via backend API.

Name: Build user dashboard subscription management UI
Description: Create user dashboard section showing current plan details and billing info, real-time subscription status, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel, access to invoices and payment history, and payment method update form. Display notifications for successful upgrades, payment failures, etc. Acceptance criteria: Dashboard reflects live subscription state from backend, all actions trigger appropriate API calls, UI is intuitive.

Name: Implement backend Stripe subscription API integration
Description: Integrate Stripe API on backend to create subscriptions when user completes checkout, process successful and failed payments, retrieve invoices and payment history, and manage subscription updates/cancellations. Use stored Price IDs. Acceptance criteria: Endpoints exist for create subscription, get subscription status, update payment method, upgrade/downgrade, cancel. All calls handle Stripe errors.

Name: Set up Stripe webhook handlers
Description: Configure Stripe webhooks and implement handlers for invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, and customer.subscription.deleted. Update internal user access rights, subscription status, and trigger notifications on events. For invoice.payment_failed, trigger user notification and email prompt to update payment info. Acceptance criteria: Webhooks verified, events processed correctly, database updated, logs captured.

Name: Implement frontend-backend integration for real-time updates
Description: Connect frontend dashboard and checkout to backend API. Ensure subscription changes made via dashboard or webhooks are reflected in real-time in UI without manual refresh. Handle API errors and show clear user notifications. Acceptance criteria: UI updates immediately after webhook events or API responses, error states displayed clearly.

Name: Create subscription flow test plan
Description: Prepare detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for full subscription flow: sign-up, checkout, billing, plan management. Include test scenarios for payment success, payment failure, cancellation, upgrade/downgrade, webhook delivery. Share plan with team. Acceptance criteria: Test plan documented, covers edge cases, approved by team.

Name: Execute integration and UAT testing
Description: Perform testing phase after initial integration, lasting one week. Execute test plan, simulate Stripe test events for payment failures and cancellations, verify webhook handlers, dashboard updates, and error notifications. Log defects and fix. Acceptance criteria: All critical flows pass, edge cases covered, no blocking bugs remain.

Name: Create user documentation and support FAQ
Description: Plan and draft user documentation and help section/FAQ covering how to manage subscriptions, access invoices, update payment methods, handle payment failures, and change plans. Make it available at launch. Acceptance criteria: Documentation published, covers common questions, links from dashboard.

Name: Document backend API and webhook handlers
Description: Document all API endpoints related to subscriptions and webhook event handlers for future maintenance and troubleshooting. Include request/response examples, Stripe event mapping, and setup instructions. Acceptance criteria: Documentation complete in repo/wiki, reviewed by Taylor.
